questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully visible (around 00:07-00:10), there are exactly three pens arranged in a row.
The left and middle pens are vertical (pointing up/down), but the rightmost pen is angled diagonally. They are not all aligned in the same direction.
All three pens appear to have translucent barrels and black caps, sharing the same color scheme.
All three pens have their dark caps visible at the bottom end (or bottom-right for the angled pen), and no bare writing tips are exposed. They appear to be equal length.
The board advances steadily from left to right throughout the clip without halting or reversing.
The pens remain fixed in their relative positions on the board as it moves.

parsed.reason: The rightmost pen is oriented diagonally while the other two are vertical, violating the condition that all pens must point the same direction.

description: One pen is flipped relative to the others (variant).
